The lecture's results come from 600 real runs. Pick a task and a prompt to see what each model did, then click a square to read that run.

```{=html}
<div id="explorer" class="column-page">
  <div class="rx-controls">
    <div class="rx-row">
      <span class="rx-label">Task</span>
      <div class="rx-pills" id="rx-tasks" role="group" aria-label="Task"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="rx-row">
      <span class="rx-label">Prompt</span>
      <div class="rx-pills" id="rx-prompts" role="group" aria-label="Prompt"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="rx-row">
      <span class="rx-label">Model</span>
      <div class="rx-pills" id="rx-models" role="group" aria-label="Model"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <blockquote class="rx-prompt" id="rx-prompt-text"></blockquote>
  <div class="rx-legend" id="rx-legend"></div>
  <div class="rx-compare" id="rx-compare"><p class="rx-loading">Loading the runs…</p></div>
  <div class="rx-list" id="rx-list"></div>
  <section class="rx-run" id="rx-run" hidden></section>
</div>
<script src="explorer/explorer.js"></script>
```
